changes.replacement: The synchronous method returns MarkdownDocument. ToMarkdownAsync returns OfficeConversionResult<MarkdownDocument>. Cast the report to AsciiDocToMarkdownReport for native spans/diagnostics. SaveAsMarkdown(path|stream) returns the same typed evidence. FailOnLoss rejects before persistence.

The synchronous method returns AsciiDocDocument. ToAsciiDocAsync returns OfficeConversionResult<AsciiDocDocument>. Cast the report to MarkdownToAsciiDocReport for native spans/diagnostics and GeneratedSource for the exact canonical text. SaveAsAsciiDoc(path|stream) writes that text and returns the same typed evidence.

Retain the attributes and reference catalog for the individual block. The out report remains AsciiDocToMarkdownReport, including used-footnote diagnostics; this is separate from whole-document conversion.

ToTarget(options, out OfficeConversionReport, cancellationToken) returns the native target. ToTargetAsync returns OfficeConversionResult<T>. Cast the out/result report to its typed conversion report; generated AsciiDoc/LaTeX source is retained by GeneratedSource on the typed report. The specialized result only serves internal projection.
